Name: OPERATION_GUIDE_PARAM_ST
Description: Button prompts shown on objects in the world (for example Spiritstream jump, Find crest, Unable to examine now): the text and where on the object it appears.

Fields.Name: Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly of the target object the prompt is attached to. -1: the object's position. Retail 220 on the three Descend/Disembark rows.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text of the on-screen guide (Menu Text).

Fields.Name: Offset Space
Fields.Description: 0: the offset is added in the world, in metres, before the prompt is placed on screen. 1: the offset is added after projection, on screen. Retail 1 on the three Descend/Disembark rows.

Fields.Name: Offset X
Fields.Description: X offset of the prompt from its anchor (see Offset Space).

Fields.Name: Offset Y
Fields.Description: Y offset of the prompt from its anchor (see Offset Space). Retail up to 2.6 (metres above the object).

Fields.Name: Offset Z
Fields.Description: Z offset of the prompt from its anchor (see Offset Space).

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.
